style: Premium miniature 3D render in one consistent clay-and-glass style: matte warm-white clay (#F4F0EA) with soft rounded pillow-like extrusions and gentle bevels, frosted translucent milky glass parts with a faint cyan tint that are dense enough that the background never shows through them, chamfered glass blocks and satin blocks like a modern tech icon, brand blue #4767EC and deep navy #0A1020 clay accents, small glowing cyan #22D3EE rim-light strips and inner glow, soft diffused studio light from the upper left with gentle shading and clean subtle reflections, viewed from the same three-quarter isometric angle about 35 degrees above, the object centred with generous empty margin and nothing touching or cropped by the image border, no cast shadow, no ground shadow, no floor, no reflection on the ground, no horizon line, plain seamless flat background of exactly {BG} with no gradient, no vignette, no texture, no glow on the background and no {BG} colour cast or reflection on the object
scene: The platform is a clean smooth rounded-square slab like a collectible figurine base with plain continuous side walls, no bumpers, no side pads, no clips, no handles; one thin glowing cyan light strip along a lower edge is allowed; every object on it is clearly readable at small size
notext: Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no trademarks, no watermark, no people.
